import * as React from /*"react"*/'blob:https://site-8a30006c899d0745c3a710357e15fd182c9e9b24ba3f4c55e16da0b9cb.framercanvas.com/42cb2ed1-a23c-4f40-9412-9db6de069d12';
export function useControlledState(value) {
    const [controlledValue, setValue] = React.useState(value);
    React.useEffect(()=>{
        setValue(value);
    }, [
        value
    ]);
    return [
        controlledValue,
        setValue
    ];
}

export const __FramerMetadata__ = {"exports":{"useControlledState":{"type":"function","annotations":{"framerContractVersion":"1"}}}}
